voice.name: Mathis - Deep, Smooth and Sophisticated
voice.why: A low, smooth baritone for Brigadier Lucien Carrel on the evening bank beat: a calm officer unwinding at the end of a shift, a different man and a different voice from the harbor inspector. Used by no other NPC.

greet.text: Good evening. I walk the bank and the square at this hour. All quiet so far.

town.text: Saint-Philippe is calm after six. A few stray dogs, a few late customers at the cafe. I like it that way.

barn.text: People talk about the old barn. I have driven by. A locked door is not a crime, and rumor is not evidence.

more.text: Ask what you like. I will answer what I can.

bell.text: The church bell marks my rounds. Six, nine, midnight. If you hear it, I am somewhere near the bank.

courier.text: The Courier printed Tuesday's robbery. Most of it is right. Do not repeat the rest.

mine.text: The coal workers head home dusty and tired. Quiet men. They give me no trouble.

more2.text: A few things for visitors, then.

market.text: Keep your cash in your pocket at the market. Pickpockets love a crowd and an open bag.

hostel.text: A bed at the hostel costs little. A night on a bench costs more, if I find you there.

who.text: Brigadier Carrel, evening patrol. If you need an officer by day, the station on the square keeps the desk.

again.text: Anything else, friend? I have a few minutes before the next lap.

bye.text: Good night. Stay out of trouble, and out of the bank after hours.

replies.town: How is the town this evening?
replies.barn: What do you know about the old barn?
